collection.name: HATS n' daCATs
collection.note: True 1:1 hats on Ethereum. Max supply 333; released in waves (currently 84 minted). No rarity tiers — every hat stands on its own. Stewarded by hatsndacats.eth. Project mint wallet excluded from holder counts until a collector receives the piece.
collection.description: HATS n' daCATs is a collection of 333 unique daCATs, each defined by a legendary hat from across the daCAT universe. Every NFT is individually named and numbered, allowing collectors to choose the legend they connect with most. There are no rarity tiers—every hat stands on its own. Every hat has a story. Legends Wear Hats.
